parsed.description: Add 5% LR warmup at unchanged MATRIX_LR 0.08 (single hyperparameter change); EVAL_TOKENS explicitly restored to the fixed 20971520.
parsed.report_to_operator: The latest run modified EVAL_TOKENS (20971520 -> 262144), which is in the protected evaluation section. Its val_bpb of 1.099894 was computed on a different, much smaller eval set and is NOT comparable to the baseline's 1.102556 (20,971,520 tokens), so I am discarding it rather than banking a spuriously 'improved' number. My next edit sets EVAL_TOKENS back to 20971520 — this is a restoration to the mandated fixed value, not a tuning change — to guarantee the standard evaluation is used going forward.
